topic: Adrian Raine, Monte Buchsbaum & Lori LaCasse (1997) FDG-PET Brain Scans of 41 Homicide Defendants vs 41 Controls, 1998 Impulsive vs Planned Subgroup Fork, Fallon & Raine's Peaceful Professor Scans, and Biosocial Prevention (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
